real_defect_found_and_fixed.description: GOVERNMENT role had system-wide write/assignment authority (canAssign: ADMIN|GOVERNMENT) over submissions but list()/getById() gated all-submission visibility on isAdmin() (ADMIN only) — a government actor could route work to any submission by id but could not list or view any submission except their own (which is always empty), discovered live via GET /submissions returning [] for government@ecotrace.com
real_defect_found_and_fixed.discovered_by: live P8.5 Government/Admin audit trail scenario execution against the real running stack
real_defect_found_and_fixed.root_cause_classification: genuine production defect (authorization inconsistency: write power without matching read/audit visibility)
real_defect_found_and_fixed.fix: added canAudit() (ADMIN|GOVERNMENT) used only by list() and new loadForAudit()/getById(); update()/delete() deliberately left on the original isAdmin()-only loadAccessible(), preserving Admin's exclusive override authority

names: list: returns every submission for a government actor (audit visibility, P8.5)
getById: returns the submission for a government actor regardless of owner (audit visibility, P8.5)

real_defect_found_and_fixed.verified_live_post_fix: GET /submissions as government@ecotrace.com now returns both real submissions, identical to admin@ecotrace.com; consumer's own-scope list unaffected
